title: --server.port does not change, always defaults to 8501
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

I installed streamlit and streamlit_authenticator in a new server, and I am not able to run multiple apps in different ports. 
Each time I run it just uses 8501 port.

### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
import streamlit as st
st.info("hello world")
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Create 2 files `a.py` and `b.py`
2. streamlit run a.py
3. streamlit run b.py --server.port 8503

### Expected Behavior

There should be 2 apps running, one in port 8501, and another in 8503

### Current Behavior

Terminal copy : 
![Screenshot 2023-09-26 at 12 13 31 PM](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/assets/23384411/f0dfbf51-3120-4567-b401-eb83a66b5802)



### Is this a regression?

- [X] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.27.0
- Python version: 3.10.0
- Operating System: SMP Debian 5.10.179-1 (2023-05-12) x86_64 GNU/Linux
- Browser: Chrome

[USER] Thanks for reporting this issue. This behavior is caused by the assignment of `serverPort = 8501` in your config file. If you comment it out, it should default to whatever you're passing in the command line flag.

```toml
[browser]

# Internet address where users should point their browsers in order to
# connect to the app. Can be IP address or DNS name and path.

# This is used to:
# - Set the correct URL for CORS and XSRF protection purposes.
# - Show the URL on the terminal
# - Open the browser

# Default: "localhost"
# The value below was set in /[HOME]/.streamlit/config.toml
serverAddress = "localhost"

# Whether to send usage statistics to Streamlit.

# Default: true
# The value below was set in /[HOME]/.streamlit/config.toml
gatherUsageStats = true

# Port where users should point their browsers in order to connect to the
# app.

# This is used to:
# - Set the correct URL for CORS and XSRF protection purposes.
# - Show the URL on the terminal
# - Open the browser

# Default: whatever value is set in server.port.
# The value below was set in /[HOME]/.streamlit/config.toml
# serverPort = 8501 <- comment this line out
```
Going to close this issue as [USER] has answered the question. Thanks Snehan!
